newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 26.

text.p: The Health and Welfare Ministry plans to cut the cost of medical equipment covered by national health insurance in order to correct the price gap between Japan and the United States and Europe. The ministry will revise its method of calculating the prices of such equipment, and start the plan from the business year starting April, 1997. The move is to prevent further deterioration of the national health insurance scheme's financial base.
